# ui-starter catalog

> Design-system catalog for product UI (Storybook + agent index). Prefer patterns, then components. Shell is the product frame.

## Start here

1. Open Patterns/Overview — pick the closest workflow. Keep Shell as the frame.
2. Search the agent index: `bun run catalog search <query>`
3. Pull dense guidance: `bun run catalog get <id> --dense`
4. For visual values, open Foundations/Theme sheet — tokens only, no hard-coded hex.

## Commands

- `bun run catalog search <query> [--kind pattern|component|module|layout|foundation|docs] [--limit n] [--dense]`
- `bun run catalog get <id> [--dense]`
- `bun run catalog list [--kind ...] [--dense]`
- `bun run catalog:build` — regenerate `packages/ui/src/catalog/catalog-index.json` after story/agent changes
- `bun run catalog:check` — freshness + vibe prompt fitness (CI)
- `bun run catalog:mcp` — stdio MCP (`catalog_search`, `catalog_get`, `catalog_list`)
- Embed without Storybook chrome: add `?embed=1` (Portfolio `/library` uses this)

## Where things live

- Patterns — workflows (create record, table-backed task flows, settings, wizard, …)
- Modules/Table — record grids; start at Overview, then Members / Find / …
- Components — controls (Button, Field, Select, …)
- Layout — frames, arrange, overlays
- Foundations — tokens; Theme sheet is the one-page semantic map
- docs/api-conventions.md — prop naming, events, tokens-only rule
- AGENTS.md — where to change code in this monorepo

## Optional

- fixtures/vibe-prompts.json — short prompts to score catalog fitness
- Storybook Agent panel — same guidance as dense export, inside the docs UI
